id: title:Gilbert09:list feedback and review tools as inbox sources

review.posthog_relevance: Adds ingestion support for feedback and review records from Bettermode, Discourse, Gainsight PX, LangSmith, Mintlify, Sleekplan, Sprig, and Okendo to PostHog's Inbox, expanding the range of external feedback sources PostHog can consume.
review.reason: The change adds configuration entries for nine specific external feedback and review products to the `EXTERNAL_INBOX_SOURCES` configuration. This is a localized, bounded capability improvement: it extends the supported ingestion sources for PostHog's Inbox feature. The implementation consists of adding configuration entries, not changing core ingestion, parsing, or delivery logic.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed addition of configuration entries. The actual benefit depends on whether these sources are actively used and successfully configured by PostHog customers, which is not demonstrated by the configuration changes alone. No tier score is assigned; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file, single-path change group. No other PRs or unrelated chunks are supplied, so no cross-PR uncertainty exists. No tier score is assigned; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds Bettermode, Discourse, Gainsight PX, LangSmith, Mintlify, Sleekplan, Sprig, Okendo, Trustpilot, and Gainsight PX entries to the EXTERNAL_INBOX_SOURCES configuration.
observations.posthog_connection: These entries extend the supported external feedback and review sources for PostHog's Inbox, allowing ingestion of feedback records from these vendors.
